data.narrative:
Recursion Pharmaceuticals is a public-stage biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector, currently valued at $1.6B after raising $2B+. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 11 comparables: 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Abridge, Chai Discovery, Freenome, and Alto Neuroscience.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. Across 6 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier peers, the median valuation stands at $2.1B, with a range spanning $539M (low) to $5.3B (high). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied due to the absence of target revenue data, a common constraint in private biotech valuation. The 3-ticker public Biotech & Health sector median P/S of 5.5x remains relevant for sector context but insufficient for direct application without disclosed revenue.

The triangulated range supports a $1.8B–$2.4B valuation, centered on a $2.1B median. Recursion's current $1.6B valuation sits at the lower bound of this range. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue disclosure, limiting revenue-multiple validation, and the wide peer range ($539M–$5.3B), reflecting heterogeneity in stage, technology maturity, and capital deployment across the biotech universe. A data refresh on pipeline progress and clinical milestones would sharpen conviction.
